main.description: Assert an entity in the programmatic advertising ecosystem into the kotoba Datom log (:adtech/*). PUBLIC ad-tech transparency data ONLY — name, role, primary domain, sellers.json seller_type / seller_id, domicile, advertiser business category (sukashi G1); reuses the shared org.corp.* id space so a listed ad-tech firm here is the same entity kabuto/tsumugi already hold. NEVER personal PII — an advertiser is a CORPORATE entity only, never a natural person, and there is no who-saw / who-clicked attribute (sukashi G9).

adtechId.description: :adtech/id; reuses org.corp.* where the firm is listed (e.g. "org.corp.us.thetradedesk"), else "adtech.<role>.<domain-kebab>" (e.g. "adtech.ssp.pubmatic")

role.description: :adtech/role (keyword without colon); :advertiser is a corporate entity only, never a person (G9)

domain.description: primary domain — the key that joins ads.txt / sellers.json / passive-dns (:domain/id)

sellerType.description: :adtech/seller-type — sellers.json seller_type (only for entities that appear in a sellers.json)

sellerId.description: :adtech/seller-id — the entity's seller_id within an exchange's sellers.json (account identifier), if disclosed

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 of domicile (public record), if known

category.description: :adtech/category — advertiser business category to surface high-risk scam-prone verticals, NEVER to profile people (G9)

listedOrg.description: :adtech/listed-org — :company/id (kabuto) / :organism/id (tsumugi) if this ad-tech firm is also a tracked listed company / power-entity (shared org.corp.* space)
